name: FireToken
fix_description: Remove the code that burns tokens directly from the LP pair balance and calls sync() during sell transfers. This mechanism (lines 266-277) directly manipulates pair reserves on every sell, creating a self-reinforcing price inflation that attackers exploit via repeated small sells followed by a final large sell at the inflated price.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is more than a trivial single-bug abuse: it uses an Aave flash loan, Uniswap V2 swap/reserve manipulation logic, and a constructor-based contract creation trick to bypass the token’s anti-contract transfer check. While the core bug is understandable once identified, reproducing the full attack requires protocol-specific reasoning across multiple contracts and several ordered steps.
